commands.name: search-records
commands.summary: Keyword search over Finna's index of books, images, archive material and museum objects, with filters, sorting and paging (public Finna API)

commands.name: get-record
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one record by its Finna id (public Finna API), optionally choosing which fields to return

commands.name: get-facets
commands.summary: List facet values with counts (formats, organisations, languages, years, ...) for a search or for the whole index; the values can be used as search-records filters

commands.name: list-organisations
commands.summary: List the organisations (libraries, archives, museums) whose material is in Finna, with record counts, from the building facet

commands.name: search-authorities
commands.summary: Search authority records for people and organisations (public Finna API)

commands.name: get-authority
commands.summary: Get one authority record (person or organisation) by id, using an id from search-authorities (public Finna API)

commands.name: get-citation
commands.summary: Get ready-made citations (APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard) for a record

commands.name: export-record
commands.summary: Export a record as a citation-manager file (RIS, BibTeX, EndNote, RefWorks, MARC ...) and return the raw text

commands.name: get-record-tab
commands.summary: Load a record page tab as an HTML fragment, e.g. library holdings/availability or user comments
